about: PHP security advisories the install doctor checks the PHP it runs on against. Written by hand: the CVEs and the fixed releases from PHP's own announcement (source), the name and the impact from OpenEMR's notice (notice) where there is one. fixed: the first release on each PHP branch with the fix. build_preflight.py copies this file to site/preflight/php-security.json, which the doctor downloads with the release facts; without it, the doctor uses the list it was released with. A new advisory is a new entry here.

advisories.name: php2shell
advisories.impact: remote code execution without logging in, actively exploited
